answer.text: A modern tax-exempt donation under Section 80G
A tradition of voluntary work in India, which has shaped the country's civil society ethos since Independence
A government-mandated labour contribution for public infrastructure

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Ch 1.1, 'shramdaan' refers to India's rich tradition of voluntary work, which has played a vital role in shaping civil society ethos since Independence. It predates formal NGO structures. **The Trap:** Option A mixes shramdaan with tax concepts. Option C implies compulsion, which is inaccurate. Option D over-specifies to CSR. **Cross-Exam Context:** Cross-links to Ch 8 (Case Studies). Knowing the civic-voluntary heritage helps interpret SE mission statements that cite community participation. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** When an SE relies heavily on volunteer labour in its impact claims, value that labour at a notional market rate (shadow-pricing) — both sides of the SROI ratio. Don't double-count volunteer hours as cost-free inputs.
